issues.detail: The only legal play bears off both checkers. The camera shows the players proceeding directly to the reset.

issueNames.repeated-player: Consecutive rolls assigned to the same player
issueNames.illegal-play: Confirmed result is illegal for the displayed roll
issueNames.observed-move-mismatch: Observed checker arrangement conflicts with the roll
issueNames.dice-disagreement: Settled dice evidence disagreed with the earlier replay
issueNames.unindexed-pair: Stationary dice outside a reconstructed roll

reviewed.text: White rolls and moves checkers between Black’s two indexed rolls. The left die shows six before the pickup.
White’s two checker transfers are 13/8 and 24/20. Only 5–4 legally makes both transfers. A die read as six in the earlier detector evidence.
The six and four are visible on the original dice. A clear view after pickup confirms that Black entered the checker and reached fixed point 10.
Black’s visible roll is 6–4. The completed board now confirms bar/21 21/15 with zero checker EV loss.
White picks up both dice at 4:18.12. The unobstructed board at 4:18.44 confirms the completed move.
Both dark dice are stationary from 4:19.56 and stay there through the long pause. The starting board agrees with White’s completed move.
Both dice show five in the original camera footage. Black plays 15/10 twice and advances the remaining checker 13/8 8/3. The completed board is visible before pickup.
Black’s 5–4 sits in the same two places through both of the earlier replay’s tick marks and through checker movement. Black collects the pair shortly before 5:12.
White’s 6–4 stays on the board during several attempted arrangements. Both dice are collected around 5:49. The two checkers ultimately move to points 7 and 9.
The settled dark dice show five and four. The completed board confirms Black’s transfers from fixed points 15 and 17 to points 19 and 22.
White throws a six and a two and gathers both dice before Black’s throw. The completed play moves fixed points 13 to 7 and 8 to 6.
Black throws into the left half. Both dark dice show five. The board confirms two Black checkers moving five pips from each of fixed points 17 and 18.
Black’s cup releases the dice into the left half. The one is clear. The two transfers on the board after pickup uniquely confirm the six and the one.
Black rolls onto a crowded point, immediately picks up, and leaves the black checker on the bar. Only one face is legible.
Repeated original-camera views read 6 and 3. Both entry points are blocked and the checker is still on the bar after pickup.
Black’s short roll lands among the lower-right checkers. Black immediately picks up, leaving the checker on the bar. White then throws from the left.
Black’s short roll shows 5–3. White’s third and fifth points are closed, so Black cannot enter from the bar.
White’s 4–1 clears both die locations at 13:08.20. Hold the same roll until pickup.
The one-frame report and the following 6–1 describe the same two Black dice. Keep the scored move.
White rolls while on the bar and picks up without entering. One die reads 3.
Repeated original-camera views read 3 and 2. Both entry points are blocked and the checker is still on the bar after pickup.
Black rolls from the bar and picks up without entering a checker.
Black’s dice settle on the right. Black picks up without entering from the bar. One face reads 4.
The camera crops at 14:37 show five pips on both dice. Point 5 is blocked and both Black checkers stay on the bar through pickup.
The two dice stay in the same positions from 14:40.12 through pickup. The camera confirms twenty pips of White checker movement, which forces double fives.
Both White dice are off the board at 14:50.28. The footage still leaves a face and the checker result uncertain.
Black rolls, picks both dice up, and leaves both checkers on the bar.
Two settled white dice show one. The clear board after pickup shifts the White checker from point 8 to point 4. Both Black checkers remain on the bar.

White picks up, then both players rearrange White’s checkers during a discussion. Black’s cup stays on the felt through all 1,542 original camera frames until White throws again. No Black throw is visible between these two White turns.
White picks up the 3–2 and makes the next visible throw. No Black throw occurs between these two pickups and throws in the recorded footage.
Black rolls 4–1 with two checkers on the bar. Both entry points are closed, and the board is unchanged when White rolls.
Black rolls and picks up without entering a checker. One face is 2. The other face is blurred, and no checker move establishes its value.
Both sides retain their checker counts through pickup; the player stays on the bar.
Black throws double fives into a closed five point with two checkers on the bar. Neither enters. The dice are picked up one at a time before White’s settled roll.
White rolls 5–2, bears off one checker from the five point, and moves the other to the three point. The full board is visible before White picks up both dice.
The original camera shows six and five. The two Black checkers enter from the bar onto fixed points 6 and 5.
The raw camera shows six and one before and after arm occlusion. White bears one checker off point 4 and one off point 1. The dice clear at 17:15.40.
White’s 4–1 stays at fixed locations until both clear at 17:38.08. Black’s next throw lands on the left half of the board.
The original dice show two and four, with the dark cup on the left half of the board. The completed position transfers Black’s rear checker six pips from fixed point 6 to point 12.

Black throws the 3–2 once and leaves both dice on the left through several checker rearrangements. The replay now scores the play from the board before the throw to the board after pickup. It drops the earlier 0.015 charge for an intermediate arrangement.

Black’s 3–2 stays in the same two positions while Black tries several checker arrangements. Both spots are clear at 21:29.68 after the hand lifts. The completed 13/11 11/8 and checker EV loss remain tied to the board before the throw.
Both dark dice stay on the left through 19:30, while Black’s sleeved hand moves the dark checkers. Join the two reads and correct the actor.
The last white dice show six and three. White transfers the last two on-board checkers directly from point 2 to point 6 while resetting. No completed bear-off is visible.
White wins 4 points, inferred from the final roll and reset.
Two new dice locations agree with the 5–3 fan. The earlier pair used a stationary checker as one die.
The two dice in the short 5–5 fan appear together. The earlier pair used a stationary checker as one die.
